How to Use

  • Let the party choose a direction or landmark from the map.
  • Use the matching number if they travel into that region.
  • Check Discovered when they learn about it or pass nearby.
  • Check Completed when they resolve it by combat, parley, escape, or clever nonsense.

Thorn Court Hunt

Path to the Convergence • Ancient forest / fey road

Masked fey hunters mistake Coleman’s giant spirit-bulldog form for sacred quarry.

Roster

1 Thorn Captain: AC16 HP70 +6, 2d8+4; 2 Briar Knights: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 3 Needle Sprites: AC13 HP12 +4, 1d6+2

Battlefield

Moving hedges, mushroom rings, low branches. At the top of each round, one path closes and another opens.

What They Want

The fey want proof the party is not poaching a sacred white stag.

Other Endings

Single combat, apology, fey token, or showing Coleman is a person.

Reward: Moonleaf clasp: ignore plant-based difficult terrain once.

Initiative / HP / Notes

2

Moss Titan Boundary

Pedle Town wildwood edge • Old forest ruin

The party crosses an invisible border and awakens a guardian older than the current kingdoms.

Roster

1 Moss Titan: AC17 HP110 +6, 2d10+4; 2 Stone Wardens: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3

Battlefield

Broken columns, buried arch, standing stones. Titan can move one terrain piece each round.

What They Want

Ancient command: “No crown-bearer may pass the Seventh Gate.”

Other Endings

Leave the boundary, hide royal symbols, place weapons down, or find the carved password.

Reward: Guardian stone: grows warm near ancient imperial ruins.

Initiative / HP / Notes

123456
3

Clockwork Mausoleum

Old road east of Veylathar • Buried road

Bronze funeral defenses rise because an ancient culture assumed all travelers were grave robbers.

Roster

1 Tomb Marshal: AC16 HP75 +6, 2d8+4; 3 Brass Dead: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 2 Key-Spiders: AC13 HP10 +4, steal item

Battlefield

Open burial shafts, sinking stone doors, brass bells under the road.

What They Want

The machines want intruders to return stolen grave tokens that nobody actually stole.

Other Endings

Ring the central bell three times, return a found token, or outrun the sinking road.

Reward: Clockwork key: opens one nonmagical lock automatically.

Initiative / HP / Notes

4

Choir of Blinding Wings

Frostgrim central pass • Mountain pass

Holy guardians judge Coleman’s shapeshifting as forbidden under an ancient, outdated law.

Roster

1 Radiant Adjudicator: AC16 HP80 +6, 2d10 radiant; 2 Winged Lancers: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 2 Halo Wisps: AC14 HP18, DC13 blind/restraint

Battlefield

Bright zones empower celestials; shade protects the party. Narrow cliffs create falling danger.

What They Want

They are not evil. They are dangerously certain they are right.

Other Endings

Invoke Arth, show mercy, protect Coleman, or force the Adjudicator to reconsider.

Reward: Dawn feather: end fear or magical darkness once.

5

Saltglass Wyrm

Izdari Sands glass basin • Giant beast

A burrowing wyrm mistakes enchanted armor and rune weapons for mineral deposits it eats.

Roster

1 Saltglass Wyrm: AC15 HP110 +6, 2d10+4; 3 Glass Mites: AC13 HP10 +4, 1d6+2

Battlefield

Crystal ridges can be shattered for 2d6 area damage. Reflections create false positions.

What They Want

It is hungry, not evil, and it wants metal more than blood.

Other Endings

Feed it metal, lure it away, protect the supply wagon until it retreats.

Reward: Three reflective scales usable by a smith.

Iron Banner Surveyors

Frostgrim western border pass • Rival kingdom

Foreign engineers are quietly marking land for a road, fort, or future invasion.

Roster

1 Banner Knight: AC16 HP75 +6, 2d8+4; 4 Pike Soldiers: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 2 Survey Adepts: AC14 HP24, DC13 smoke/trip lines

Battlefield

Survey chains trip movement; black stakes mark enemy firing lanes.

What They Want

They want to finish their map and leave with it.

Other Endings

Duel, seize the map, negotiate, expose an expired treaty, or escort them away.

Reward: Border map showing a safe pass and abandoned fort.

Blackwake Marauders

Icewind Port / southern coast • Pirate thieves

Hidden chains drag the party’s ferry sideways toward a black-sailed raider ship.

Roster

1 Pirate Captain: AC16 HP70 +6, 2d8+4; 3 Deck Raiders: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 3 Rope-Runners: AC13 HP18 +4, steal item

Battlefield

Two moving decks, ropes, cargo, deep water. Falling overboard costs a turn unless rescued.

What They Want

They want food, medicine, weapons, and royal-looking valuables.

Other Endings

Cut the chain, seize the winch, board their ship, bargain, or scare them off.

Reward: Pirate route chart and grappling launcher.

Skyhook Reavers

Izdari Sands caravan road • Airship pirates

An airship drops hooked chains and begins lifting soldiers, wagons, and heroes into the sky.

Singing Stones

Dawnmoor cliffs / lower Serenth canyon • Elemental hazard

A magical windstorm awakens stone creatures whose song shatters metal and pushes travelers toward danger.

Roster

1 Resonance Giant: AC16 HP90 +6, 2d10 thunder; 3 Chime Golems: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 2 Windlings: AC14 HP20, DC13 push

Battlefield

Gust lanes push targets 10 feet. Metal items hum and may be dropped.

What They Want

The stones are reacting to sound, not choosing sides.

Other Endings

Break the harmony, topple a standing stone, match the melody, or survive the storm.

Reward: Chime shard: whisper 300 feet through stone.

Ashmaw Pack

Mirewood Bog • Seven Hells wildlife

Beasts descended from creatures stranded during an ancient opening to the Seven Hells hunt the party’s food.

Roster

1 Ashmaw Alpha: AC14 HP70 +5, 2d8+3; 4 Cinder Hounds: AC13 HP22 +4, 1d6+2 fire; 2 Ember Bats: AC13 HP12, smoke cloud

Steam clouds, burning reeds, wet ground, food sacks under attack.

Dead King’s Watch

Western old battlefield near Pedle Town • Honorable undead

The Garrison banner resembles that of an ancient enemy, awakening soldiers who still guard a lost kingdom.

Roster

1 Oathbound General: AC16 HP85 +6, 2d10+4; 4 Grave Guards: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 2 Banner Shades: AC14 HP18, fear DC13

Battlefield

Trenches, broken shields, spectral banners. Tearing down banners weakens fear effects.

What They Want

They believe the old war is still happening.

Other Endings

Lower the banner, speak the lost kingdom’s name, duel the General, or return his sword.

Reward: Oath coin: demand one minute of parley with undead soldiers once.

Griffin Patrol

Sunreach border road • Rival air cavalry

A neighboring kingdom’s griffin riders mistake Fiona’s Garrison squad for an unauthorized military incursion.

Roster

1 Griffin Commander: AC16 HP70 +6, 2d8+4; 2 Griffin Riders: AC15 HP32 +5, 1d8+3; 3 Griffins: AC14 HP40 +5, 2d6+3
